source.locator: Your First Session: prerequisites, Ask/Agent modes and choosing an agent

observations: Requires repository indexing/setup before a cloud session. Describes choosing repositories, planning in Ask mode and sending the plan to Agent mode.
Describes code changes, commands, browser use and pull requests. Explains selectable agents and differing cost/capability; availability depends on administration and plan.
Describes optional network and MCP allowlists, git read-only/full scope and GitHub CLI token restrictions.
Recommended profiles may be overridden; mandatory profiles constrain lower scopes. Existing sessions resolve changed restrictions on resume/reboot, not automatically mid-session.
These documented controls were not tested and are not proof of isolation or safety.
Public terms govern registered access to the Cognition platform and describe account/password responsibilities and usage restrictions.
Terms allow customer data use for training by default, with a paid-tier opt-out and Teams administrator control; exceptions to zero retention include abuse and legal process.

source.locator: Privacy & Intellectual Property: retention and model training

observations: Publisher states customer data is retained for the customer relationship unless otherwise specified; feedback and interaction data may be kept as long as Cognition determines necessary.
Publisher states training is enabled by default with paid-plan opt-out; enterprise training requires express written consent. This receipt records disclosures, not compliance verification.
Pricing page lists paid access to cloud agents and explains daily/weekly included allowances and additional usage at API pricing.
Per-message cost varies with model, task size and reasoning. No purchase or billed API call was made; check current pricing before use.
